text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the final race of the year,
the Arima Kinen, is finally about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Fan
text_block_list.text: The Empress is taking this year's Arima...! I just know it...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What a star-studded lineup this year, too...
I can't wait to see who wins...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Just as expected of the 'Arima Kinen.' The crowd's pressure reaches all the way here..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family...
I cannot bring shame upon myself before my seniors and everyone in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was already planning on it.
—I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Super-duper neat☆
Everyone today is just so marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Super-duper neat☆
Everyone today is just so marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's gonna be a marvelous race~☆
So thrilling, sparkling, and exciting~~★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's in such incredible condition...!
So this is the Senior Class...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Still... the most amazing one is definitely...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for your support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove-senpai...!
Such immense pressure...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So you're here, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, up close... it's suffocating...!
What unbelievable... pressure...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Those gathered here today,
yourself included, are all truly exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare let yourself be swallowed so easily.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Right, don't let them intimidate you...!
I have to challenge the seniors head-on...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to working with you... today!
